title: Python Safe File Operations
description: Python pattern for safe file operations: open with 'x' mode for exclusive creation, write atomically, rename for atomic commit.

steps.description: Import: os module for file operations.
Temp file: write to tmp_path first, 'x' mode raises FileExistsError if file exists.
Write: write content to temporary file.
Atomic commit: os.replace atomically replaces target with tmp_path.
